displayName: SafeRoute staging: routing engine answers with 5xx

documentation.content:
More than 5 responses with a 5xx status from the routing services (saferoute-osrm-walking, saferoute-osrm-driving) within 5 minutes.

What to do: docs/runbooks/alerts-staging.md, section "When an alert arrives". Do not paste project ids, URLs or tokens when asking for help.

conditions.displayName: 5xx responses from the routing services in 5 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = starts_with("saferoute-osrm-") AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class = "5xx"
